name: Restore User Data After Move
description: Finds played state, resume positions, favourites and ratings that Jellyfin stranded when a media path changed and restores them onto the item that holds that media now. One scheduled task, running nightly. Repeat runs are no-ops, it never overwrites state you have since set, and the stranded rows are never modified or deleted.
overview: Recovers user data Jellyfin stranded when media paths changed
